hero.title: Safwan
hero.subtitle: Electronics Engineer, Software & Multimedia Developer
hero.description: Final-year Electrical & Electronics Engineering student and Software Developer. I develop integrated solutions bridging physical systems (Arduino, IoT) and AI technologies (PyTorch, LLMs) with modern web frameworks (React, TypeScript, Tailwind) and multimedia design — graphics, video, and interactive experiences.

about.label: About Me
about.title: Professional Profile
about.bio_1: I am a final-year Electrical and Electronics Engineering student based in Turkey. I specialize in designing highly efficient, integrated systems by leveraging a broad skill set across electronics engineering, artificial intelligence, software development, and multimedia design.
about.bio_2: In the engineering domain, I leverage advanced analytical skills to diagnose complex electronic circuits and design control systems, utilizing tools like Arduino and MATLAB/Simulink. Driven by the belief that the best technical solutions seamlessly blend physical hardware with intelligent software, I bridge engineering with Artificial Intelligence, using Python and PyTorch, alongside LLM APIs and AI Agents to build smart, effective applications.
about.bio_3: On the software front, I develop web applications using frameworks like TypeScript, HTML/CSS, React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite, integrating tools like Three.js and React Three Fiber to create advanced interactive interfaces. I manage my projects using Git/GitHub and Docker. I also have a strong passion for multimedia and game design, where I work on interactive experiences and 3D graphics using Blender, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, and the Godot Engine.
about.education_val: B.Sc. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering

sign2speech.title: Sign2Speech
sign2speech.description: A wearable embedded system that translates hand gestures into real-time audio. Powered by Arduino and Python, it utilizes custom signal processing algorithms to facilitate seamless, non-verbal communication.

portfolio.title: Portfolio Website
portfolio.description: An interactive, multilingual portfolio website built with React and Tailwind technologies. Features custom visual effects, along with an integrated AI-powered smart assistant for an interactive and unique browsing experience.

boost_converter_pwm.title: Boost Converter PWM
boost_converter_pwm.description: A closed-loop control system built on Arduino to regulate voltage via dynamic PWM adjustments. Includes a real-time serial interface for monitoring and diagnostics.

astrododge-pygame.title: AstroDodge (Pygame)
astrododge-pygame.description: A fast-paced 2D space survival game built in Python. Engineered with a custom Pygame rendering system, pixel-perfect collision detection, and dynamic difficulty scaling.
